deployment_blockers.detail: DOS/F413 and external Panda physical identities and wiring remain unconfirmed.
C3XL OS/camera/USB/SPI/thermal runtime has not executed these candidates.
Installed bootstub/app ABI, trusted signing and independently tested recovery are not established.
C3XL was sold without a driver camera; equivalent validated driver monitoring is unresolved.
Required audible alert output and failure handling remain unvalidated.
Song PLUS controller, signal validation and dedicated independent safety are not implemented or vehicle-validated.
P8 removes the candidate H7 cookie/buffer overlap. Physical MCU capacity and complete nested stack/target runtime proof remain unverified.
Both debug and nondebug candidates use the public development key; no deployment trust chain or install package exists.

note: Offline integration and layout fixes do not prove target runtime, worst-case stack, identity or vehicle semantics.
